# contraco

> Premium transformation consulting. Founded 1998 by Frank Meltke. Global hub at contraco.com.

contraco.com is the global hub and brand anchor for contraco, and the x-default target for the estate. Content is published in English, German, Russian and Korean on the four domains below.

## Focus

contraco works at the intersection where distribution architecture meets liability, in the moment AI agents begin buying on their own behalf: agentic commerce governance, attribution of autonomous agent declarations, AI visibility of product data, and travel distribution.

## Domains

- [English](https://contraco.net)
- [German](https://contraco.de)
- [Russian](https://contraco.ru)
- [Korean](https://contraco.co.kr)
